name: Sherin
description: Private workspace for generative media with own key, domain, and storage.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: The public HTTPS URL for this Sherin deployment.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: The single Google account email allowed into the Sherin dashboard.

INFERENCE_PROVIDER.description: Use bfl for Black Forest Labs direct execution, or babysea for BabySea SDK execution.

BFL_API_KEY.description: Black Forest Labs API key, required when INFERENCE_PROVIDER=bfl.

BFL_API_BASE_URL.description: Black Forest Labs API base URL.

BABYSEA_API_KEY.description: BabySea API key, required when INFERENCE_PROVIDER=babysea.

STORAGE_PROVIDER.description: Storage backend for generated media and references.

CUSTOM_USER_STORAGE_QUOTA_GB.description: Per-owner stored image quota in GB.
